clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 2; prohibits using the service for gambling, gambling games, “private servers,” cheats, and other illegal internet activities. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the user uses the service for a listed activity or facilitates such conduct. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the service for gambling, gambling games, “private servers,” cheats, or other illegal internet activities, or facilitate such conduct.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service for the specified activities or facilitating them, including conduct by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 3; prohibits publishing, transmitting, or disseminating email advertising or spam using the service. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to publishing, transmitting, or disseminating email advertising or spam, or facilitating that conduct. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not publish, transmit, or disseminate email advertising or spam using the service, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Email advertisements or spam distributed using the Baidu Intelligent Cloud service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to distribute or facilitate distribution, including distribution by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 4; prohibits publishing, transmitting, or disseminating unwanted or unsolicited emails, email or SMS advertisements, or emails or text messages containing reactionary, pornographic, or other harmful information. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to the listed unwanted, unsolicited, or harmful messages, or facilitating their distribution. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not publish, transmit, or disseminate unwanted or unsolicited emails, email advertisements, SMS advertisements, or emails or text messages containing reactionary, pornographic, or other harmful information, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: The specified emails, advertisements, and text messages distributed using the Baidu Intelligent Cloud service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to distribute or facilitate distribution, including distribution by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 5; prohibits establishing or using equipment or configurations to run programs or processes unrelated to the service when they cause the specified excessive resource consumption and serious burden or disruption. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when unrelated programs or processes cause large consumption of server memory, CPU, or network bandwidth and result in the described serious burden, impaired connectivity, outage, or inaccessibility. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not establish or use equipment or configurations to run programs or processes unrelated to the service when they cause excessive server memory, CPU, or network bandwidth consumption resulting in the specified serious burden, disruption, outage, or inaccessibility; do not facilitate this conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service and its computing resources
obligation_items.trigger: When unrelated programs or processes cause the serious burden or disruption described in item 5, including when facilitating end-user conduct.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 6; prohibits network-security attacks, malicious scanning, unlawful system intrusion, and unlawful data acquisition using the service. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition includes the listed examples: viruses, trojans, malicious code, phishing, malicious scanning, unlawful system intrusion, and unlawful data acquisition. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not damage or attempt to damage network security, including through viruses, trojans, malicious code, phishing, malicious scanning, unlawful system intrusion, or unlawful data acquisition, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service, networks, systems, and data accessed or affected through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to perform or facilitate the specified conduct, including conduct by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 7; prohibits changing or attempting to change system configuration provided by the service or damaging system security. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers actual or attempted configuration changes and damage to system security. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not change or attempt to change the system configuration provided by the service or damage system security, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service system configuration and security
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to perform or facilitate the specified conduct, including conduct by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 8; prohibits using technical or other means to damage or disrupt service operations or another person’s use of the service. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to using technical or other means to damage or disrupt service operations or another person’s use. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not use technical or other means to damage or disrupt service operations or another person’s use of the service, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service and other users’ use of it
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to perform or facilitate the specified conduct, including conduct by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 9; prohibits interfering or attempting to interfere with normal operation of any Baidu product, product part, or function. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers actual or attempted interference with normal operation. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not interfere or attempt to interfere with normal operation of any Baidu product, product part, or function, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu products, product parts, and functions
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to perform or facilitate the specified conduct, including conduct by an end user.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 9; separately prohibits making, publishing, or disseminating tools or methods for interfering with normal operation of Baidu products, product parts, or functions. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies to making, publishing, or disseminating tools or methods for interference, or facilitating that conduct. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not make, publish, or disseminate tools or methods for interfering with normal operation of Baidu products, product parts, or functions, or facilitate that conduct.
obligation_items.object: Tools or methods for interference with Baidu products, product parts, or functions
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever making, publishing, or disseminating such tools or methods using the service, or facilitating that conduct.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, User Conduct Legality Requirements, item 10; prohibits conduct that may violate good faith, public order and morals, or public morality, as well as publishing false information or inducing users to share false information. The section introduction also prohibits facilitating the listed conduct, including end-user conduct.
clauses.condition_explanation: The alternatives are the item’s distinct categories: conduct that may violate good faith, public order and morals, or public morality; publishing false information; or inducing users to share false information. The surrounding section introduction at lines 193–194 supplies the facilitation scope.

obligation_items.content: Do not engage in conduct that may violate good faith, public order and morals, or public morality; publish false information; or induce users to share false information, or facilitate such conduct.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service and information handled or published using it
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to perform or facilitate the specified conduct, including conduct by an end user.

paragraph_audit.reason: The item’s prohibition on using the service for the listed illegal internet activities, including the section-wide prohibition on facilitating them, is modeled.
The prohibition on publishing, transmitting, or disseminating email advertising or spam, including facilitation under the section introduction, is modeled.
The prohibition on distributing the listed unwanted, unsolicited, or harmful messages, including facilitation under the section introduction, is modeled.
The prohibition applies when unrelated programs or processes cause the specified excessive resource use and serious burden or disruption; that threshold and facilitation scope are modeled.
The prohibition on network-security attacks, unlawful intrusion, and unlawful data acquisition, including the listed examples and facilitation scope, is modeled.
The prohibition on changing or attempting to change service system configuration or damaging system security, including facilitation, is modeled.
The prohibition on damaging or disrupting service operations or another person’s use, including facilitation, is modeled.
Both the interference prohibition and its separate prohibition on making, publishing, or disseminating interference tools or methods are modeled.
The listed good-faith, public-order, and public-morality conduct and the separate false-information and inducement prohibitions are modeled.
